v1_definition: A complete first release means four self-contained field units can be installed, joined, recovered, and tested without depending on a phone, server, or repeater.

milestones.name: Architecture and safety contracts
milestones.description: Protocol, recovery, privacy, group-size, and degraded-operation rules are documented and extensively host tested.
milestones.next_gate: Close remaining product-firmware architecture gates with target evidence.

milestones.name: Core OpenTrail firmware
milestones.description: Hardware-neutral communication, status, alert, persistence, update, and recovery components plus a portable-client composition exist; real board bindings remain.
milestones.next_gate: Bind the selected client hardware and prove the complete target composition.

milestones.name: Firmware loading app
milestones.description: A packaged Windows inspection shell identifies the three bench runtimes, presents non-authoritative vendor-family hardware candidates with explicit maintenance steps, and verifies bounded bundle structure, image SHA-256, and RSA-PSS-3072/SHA-256 when a signer is pinned; production trust, authoritative board matching, writing, and recovery remain absent.
milestones.next_gate: Run separately authorized maintenance probes for received-board evidence, obtain independent trust review, and approve signer custody plus pinned production trust before implementing any writer.

milestones.name: Heltec V4 bench firmware
milestones.description: Two assembled Heltec V4 units provide limited radio and USB bench evidence through temporary MeshCore firmware; native OpenTrail target firmware has not run on them.
milestones.next_gate: Build, flash, recover, and exercise native OpenTrail firmware on both Heltec units.

milestones.name: Firmware for the first complete unit
milestones.description: The display, internal radio/GNSS module, power path, enclosure, and exact production target still require a frozen build and integration.
milestones.next_gate: Freeze the exact hardware and complete one recoverable end-to-end client.

milestones.name: Four-person V1 field proof
milestones.description: Four identical standalone clients must pass recovery, range, endurance, usability, and repeatable field trials before V1.
milestones.next_gate: Run the frozen four-unit standalone pilot and accept its evidence.

change_log.reason: Added packaged three-device runtime inspection, candidate-only hardware guidance, bounded firmware-bundle structure/image-digest/host RSA-PSS, and fixed cross-tool vector verification; production signer trust, board authority, and writing remain absent, so the weighted percentage is unchanged.
Established the first evidence-weighted V1 baseline for public progress reporting.
